prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A single, perfectly round waffle sits centered on a plain white ceramic plate, which is itself placed on a smooth, neutral beige tabletop. The waffle is strikingly colored in a deep, vivid blue, creating a surreal and visually arresting focal point. The texture of the waffle is crisp and well-defined, with each square pocket casting subtle shadows that enhance its three-dimensionality. The lighting is soft and diffuse, eliminating harsh shadows and giving the scene a clean, almost clinical clarity. Above the plate, bold black text in all caps reads: “9/10 PEOPLE CANNOT FIND THIS IMAGE ON GOOGLE IMAGES,” adding a playful, meme-like quality to the composition. The overall style is minimalist and modern, with a straightforward, eye-level camera angle and a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus sharply on the blue waffle and plate, while the background remains unobtrusive. The color palette is dominated by the contrast between the intense blue of the waffle and the muted, neutral tones of the plate and background, creating a visually impactful and slightly surreal image.
